_note: sync-v2 §11.5 takedown write plane. Drives setVersionAvailabilityTx against a scratch catalog pinned at 3 + the same seeded versions the read check uses. Pins INV-17: a takedown is metadata-only and NEVER re-pins — dataset.current_version is byte-equal to the seed after EVERY op, including a withdraw of the pinned version itself (the read side walks down at resolution, registry.ts::resolveVersionRow). Pins INV-8: only the `available` flag mutates; the bytes-bearing columns stay byte-identical. withdraw(9) fails, no flag/pin move.
